subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 upstream action revisions as one privileged workflow update after exact-head checks and direct source review?
rationale: Several updated actions execute with secrets or write-capable tokens, and repository policy requires maintainer-owned supply-chain judgment plus direct Codex contract inspection that cannot be resolved from the pin-only diff.

options.title: Verify and land the batch
options.body: Review the privileged upstream diffs, complete the Codex source gate, and merge the immutable pins after all required exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, registry, release, and Codex action updates from lower-risk setup and scanning bumps so each security boundary can be validated independently.

options.title: Pause for regeneration
options.body: Leave the batch unmerged and allow Dependabot to regenerate narrower updates if the combined security review is not worth the operational risk.

recommendation.title: Verify and land the batch
recommendation.body: Review the privileged upstream diffs, complete the Codex source gate, and merge the immutable pins after all required exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to release workflows and broad CI maintenance affected by the grouped update.
